_about: 1-Pentanol (1) + Isooctane (2): isothermal total pressures at 313.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1-pentanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: A. Moreau, M. C. Martin, F. Aguilar, J. J. Segovia, Vapour liquid equilibria and excess enthalpies of the binary mixtures 1-pentanol  with 2,2,4-trimethylpentane or n-heptane, Fluid Phase Equilib. 338 (2013) 95-99
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1, 2. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
